headline: Project view gets thumbnails, List view and Icon view too.
notes: Project view now has the same three views as a clip: List, List with thumbnails, and Icon view. Every file gets a frame, from its first use if it is in your edit, or made in the background if it is not
Offline files show Premiere's own red Media Offline card instead of an empty frame
Thumbnails come faster: the rows on screen go first, three are made at once, and every frame is kept on disk, so a clip you open again shows its pictures straight away
In This cut the three view buttons and the size slider are greyed out, as they only work on a clip's uses and in Project view
A long bin path under a name in Project view now stops before the Type column, and a path more than three bins deep shows only its last three. Point at it to read the whole path
The count between the arrows in the bottom bar is centred
